reviews.text: Have you ever wanted to win Trade, Delist and Draft your way to premiership glory? well this is the game for you. A fast based game that has you deciding if you want to trade your star midfielder after a few losses for a up and coming forward who might just win you enough games to keep you in the job for another season, Can you strike gold a recruit enough superstars for a dynasty or will you have to pick the bottom of the barrel to keep your season alive. if you're not familiar with Australian Football, it doesn't matter, this game plays like Slay the Spire with a sprinkle of Football Manager spice and will have you hooked to play just one more season at the end of each run.

Squiggle Football scratches some crazy itch that I didn't know could be scratched. It's a chaotic mix of sports simulation, auto-battler, and card game, that you can't help but keep playing one more game of. The game's creator is no stranger to making niche games that hook you, having created the webgame NationStates, and has astoundingly knocked it out of the park yet again.

>appointed as coach of Woop Woop Warriors >coaches team to undefeated Bush League season and premiership win >offered 1-year extension >coaches team to another undefeated season and premiership win >fired by the board due to having a "horrific list profile" 10/10 most accurate AFL management sim ever Jokes aside, massive kudos to the creator (Max Barry). I never would've thought to combine a sports (let alone Aussie Rules!) management sim with deck-building mechanics like Squiggle Football does, but it just works! Combines one of my favourite game genres with one of my favourite sports - can definitely see myself sinking many hours into this.

In theory a great game. Have put many hours into it and it was mostly enjoyable. It's just too limiting. One bad season and you're gone. Only 1 year contracts. It gets to the point where your players are so much better than the opposition however year on year their team rating improves, no matter how crappy their players are. No amount of game plan cards helps. You end up with so many innovation points which are useless as there are no good players to trade for or decent recruits. Even if there were you will still lose to the oppostion. Eventually you just can't compete. Pretty frustrating really.

Enjoying the game but not a fan of the arbitrary inflation teams seem to get after each season in the National League. At season 10 in National League most teams sit at 130 overall with absolute ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ players making up 90% of their roster. I'm assuming the only way through this is to replace my coaches with higher stats and aim for more game plans that target 3 players. Replacing coaches feels bad as it reduces your effective traits from 7 (3 cultures + 4 between coaches) to 5 which can handicap your innovation generation. It'd be nice to see coaches with two traits in the national league to up with innovation generation, or a way to improve the bonus from coaches.
